step1_analysis.description: A passive loop filter operating in the capacitance domain for a phase-locked loop (PLL). It takes current pulses from a dual-path charge pump (integral and proportional paths) and filters them to generate control voltages across varactor diodes, which tune the VCO frequency.

paper_reference.title: A 1.5-V 900-MHz Monolithic CMOS Fast-Switching Frequency Synthesizer for Wireless Applications

power_consumption.description: Total power consumption of the PLL

sky130_expected.reasoning: The extracted netlist is a passive loop filter, which consumes zero DC power.

phase_noise.description: Phase noise of the PLL at 600-kHz offset

sky130_expected.reasoning: Cannot be simulated with just the loop filter netlist.

z_prop_dc.description: DC transimpedance of the proportional path

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by R1 in the netlist, as capacitors act as open circuits at DC.

z_int_100k.description: Transimpedance magnitude of the integral path at 100 kHz

sky130_expected.reasoning: Dominated by the parallel combination of C2 and C4 at 100 kHz.

z_prop_100k.description: Transimpedance magnitude of the proportional path at 100 kHz

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated from the RC network of the proportional path.

step3_testbench.description: AC analysis to measure the transimpedance of the integral and proportional paths of the loop filter.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Dual-Path PLL Loop Filter
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* DUT
D1 N2 N0
D2 N2 N0
D4 N2 N0
D3 N3 N0
C1 N3 GND 5.2p
C2 14uA GND 41p
C3 140uA GND 1.7p
R1 140uA GND 153k
C4 N2 GND 52p
R2 N3 140uA 51k
R3 14uA N2 5k

* Bias the VCO tank node to ground
V_N0 N0 0 0V

* Add a large resistor to prevent floating nodes on the integral path
R_leak 14uA 0 1G

* AC Current sources for the two paths
I_int 0 14uA AC 1
I_prop 0 140uA AC 1

* Dummy diode models in case the parser requires them for D1-D4
.model DMOD D (CJO=1p)
.model N0 D (CJO=1p)

.control
ac dec 10 10 1Meg

* Integral path impedance
let z_int = v(14uA)
let z_int_mag = mag(z_int)
let phase_int = 180/PI * cph(z_int)

* Proportional path impedance
let z_prop = v(140uA)
let z_prop_mag = mag(z_prop)
let phase_prop = 180/PI * cph(z_prop)

meas ac z_prop_dc find z_prop_mag at=10
meas ac z_int_100k find z_int_mag at=100k
meas ac z_prop_100k find z_prop_mag at=100k
meas ac phase_int_100k find phase_int at=100k
meas ac phase_prop_100k find phase_prop at=100k

print z_prop_dc z_int_100k z_prop_100k phase_int_100k phase_prop_100k
quit
.endc
